title: Measurability of the Gaussian plane density
statement: The function on $\mathbb{R}^2$ given by $(u,v)\mapsto \varphi(u)\varphi(v)$ is measurable, where $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density on $\mathbb{R}$.
